tasks.GetLastGiraffeName: Retrieve the last name in the sorted list of giraffes.

Questions.content: What is the criteria for determining the "last" giraffe name in the sorted list? Is it based on the last character of the alphabet or the last name in the sorted order?

Answers.content:
The criteria for determining the "last" giraffe name in the sorted list is based on the last name in the sorted order. Alphabetical sorting arranges names from A to Z, and the last name in this sequence would be the one that comes last when sorted alphabetically. In the given list of giraffes:

name, age, height (cm), weight (kg)
Jody, 5, 430, 620
Gladys, 10, 420, 590
Marian, 2, 310, 410
Donna, 9, 440, 650

When sorted alphabetically by name, the order is:

1. Donna
2. Gladys
3. Jody
4. Marian

Therefore, the last giraffe name in the sorted list is "Marian".
